# design.volt.link

design.volt.link is the public Volt design guide for logo usage, colours, typography, layout, accessibility, design tokens, websites, social media, presentations, files, downloads, templates and practical applications.

## Important URLs

- Public guide: https://design.volt.link/
- How to use the guide: https://design.volt.link/#guideUsage
- Decision guide: https://design.volt.link/#decisionGuide
- Design tokens: https://design.volt.link/#designTokens
- Downloads and templates: https://design.volt.link/#downloads
- Glossary: https://design.volt.link/#glossary
- AI and machine readability: https://design.volt.link/#machineReadability
- Sitemap: https://design.volt.link/sitemap.xml
- Robots policy: https://design.volt.link/robots.txt
- Logo preview image: https://design.volt.link/design.volt.link_logo_lila.png

## Languages

The interface supports German, English, Dutch and French. The primary language follows the browser language where possible.

## Scope

The site is a version-1 static guide. It has no login and no backend. Public scaffold pages describe how future content should be maintained before detailed templates and downloads are filled in.

## Content Status

Content can be required, recommended, experimental or archived. Archived material is visible for context only and should not be used as the basis for new publications.

## Usage Notes

Use the current public guide for orientation. Check page status, update date, ownership and official sources before treating guidance as final. Legal notes in the guide are informational and do not replace formal legal approval.
